jobs.name: Creature of Habit

jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist achievement emblem for the center of an existing game badge, part of a consistent Corporation Loyalty family.
Style: smooth raised ivory enamel with narrow warm-gold rims, shallow polished bevels, thin dark edges, soft highlights from upper left. Front-on orthographic pictogram. Broad solid shapes, no texture or engraved details. Recognizable at small sizes.
The corporation-card motif is a simple upright rounded rectangle, ivory face with a narrow gold border. No card text, no game statistics, no tiny markings. Keep any symbol on a card large and simple.
Composition: compact and balanced, centered on a square transparent canvas with at least 15 percent clear margin; every object fully visible. Only the described objects.
Background: actual transparent alpha PNG. Fully transparent outside objects and in every gap. No backdrop, no black fill, no glow, no haze, no cast shadow.
Avoid: outer badge frame, extra objects, background disc, laurels, scenery, text, letters, numerals, logos of real corporations, presentation sheet.
Subject: Exactly TWO equal-size upright corporation cards standing side by side with a small clear gap. Each card bears the EXACT SAME large solid gold hexagon centered on its ivory face. Both cards have identical shapes, colors and symbols; no overlap. Only two cards.

jobs.name: Prelude Completionist
jobs.symbol: The magenta Prelude token with its white chevron and a polished gold outer rim.
jobs.description: Won with all five Prelude corporations at least once.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the magenta Prelude logo with a white outer rim and a white chevron. Input image 2 is ONLY a reference for the polished GOLD material on its outer border; do not copy its hexagon, blue face, V, or gold-edged lettering.
Change ONLY the thin WHITE OUTER RIM of image 1 to warm polished metallic GOLD, matching the hue and restrained beveled finish of the outer rim in image 2. Keep the rim the same width and follow the existing flared outline and rounded corners exactly. Use clean smooth gold edges, a thin dark edge and subtle upper-left highlights. Gold must be clearly visible around the entire perimeter; remove any leftover white fringe outside the rim.
Keep the CENTER CHEVRON solid WHITE and unchanged. Preserve the magenta/pink face, dark-purple inset band, existing gradients, silhouette, proportions, view, layout, and padding. The only color/material change is the outer rim from white to gold. No extra borders, ornaments, frame, symbols, lettering, sparkles, background or cast shadow. Preserve a genuinely transparent background, including outside the smooth gold edge. One logo only.

Change ONLY the outer rim of image 1 from white to gold, matching the gold border of image 2 exactly in hue, smoothness, width and shallow metallic bevel. Gold follows the existing flared outline and rounded corners, with a thin dark edge and restrained upper-left highlights. Make the entire perimeter gold and clean away stray white specks outside the rim.
Keep both CENTER BARS solid WHITE. Preserve their existing shape, width, height, generous gap and position, keeping II as the ONLY symbol inside the token. Do not copy the chevron from image 2. Preserve the original magenta/pink face, purple inset band, gradients, silhouette, proportions, view and padding. Do not change any other color or part of the logo. No extra border, numeral, symbol, gold on the white bars, ornament, badge frame, scenery, backdrop, glow or cast shadow. Genuine transparent alpha around the smooth gold silhouette. One logo only. Text verbatim: "II".

jobs.name: Promo Completionist
jobs.symbol: The black Promo square with a single ivory circle and polished gold edge.
jobs.description: Won with all ten Promo corporations in the achievement catalogue at least once.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE standalone expansion emblem for an achievement badge. Genuinely transparent background.
Input 1 is the exact symbol/color reference; input 2 is ONLY the style/material reference. Match reference 2’s polished gold trim, clean enamel face, shallow raised bevel, thin dark rim and upper-left highlights. Do not depict its Venus V or hexagon.
Front-facing, minimal, centered, broad simple forms readable at small sizes, generous transparent margin. No badge outer frame, surrounding backing plate, scene, sparkles, captions, cast shadow, or extra objects. Preserve only the requested symbol.
Subject: the supplied Promo symbol: one front-facing black square with ONE large centered solid white circle. Preserve the simple square-and-circle geometry, no perspective distortion. Clean black enamel square face, a slim polished warm-gold bevelled square rim replacing the original white/gray square border, and a solid ivory-enamel circle in its center. The ivory circle is a disk, not a hole or ring, and needs no concentric rings. Outside the square is transparent. No letters or numbers.

rules.venus-veteran: Won at least once with each of the five Venus corporations listed in the achievement plan.
rules.colonial-conqueror: Won at least once with each of the five Colonies corporations listed in the achievement plan.
rules.agent-of-chaos: Won at least once with each of the five Turmoil corporations listed in the achievement plan.
rules.prelude-completionist: Won at least once with every corporation in this badge’s explicitly listed set, across tournament history. Artwork and scope notes only; achievement evaluation is not implemented in the studio.
rules.prelude-ii-completionist: Won at least once with every corporation in this badge’s explicitly listed set, across tournament history. Artwork and scope notes only; achievement evaluation is not implemented in the studio.
rules.promo-completionist: Won at least once with every corporation in this badge’s explicitly listed set, across tournament history. Artwork and scope notes only; achievement evaluation is not implemented in the studio.

notes.expansionFamily: Dedicated achievement emblems derived from the supplied Venus, Colonies and Turmoil symbols. The original expansion logos remain available unchanged in the logo picker.
notes.preludeAndPromo: Prelude and Prelude II share polished gold outer rims matching the expansion family. Prelude keeps its white chevron; Prelude II has two broad white bars forming II, with a generous gap for readability. White-rim reference artwork is retained beside the masters. The II is a studio-specific marker. Promo eligibility follows the ten corporations in the current private plan. Corporation lists and source links live in concepts.json and are shown on the section page.
